_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Equal-weight score is coiled (only 3% of recent windows move ±2); stress and crowded longs keep risk-off pressure but are not yet a rung-breaker up or down.
next_move.brains_agree: No—analyst holds phase at Anxiety with tactical SHORT; narrative leans accumulation-bottom without an explicit phase call
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC chops post-opex low to ~80k, fear 25-40, 30d momentum stays flat near 50
next_move.invalidated_if: 30d momentum breaks with fear <20 (down to Denial) or sustained reclaim >81200 with CVD and ETF flows turning up (up to Complacency)
